description: This file defines a Java interface ContentImageGet that extends ImageGet, providing methods for retrieving images and their names from a content management system within a sales manager core module.

classes.name: ContentImageGet
classes.description: A Java interface for retrieving content images and image names, extending the ImageGet interface with specific methods for content image management.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image as an OutputContentFile given merchant store code, image name, and content type.

methods.name: getImageNames
methods.description: Returns a list of image names for a given merchant store code and content type.
